text: For to use the knife, unless in the extremest necessity, is neither good surgery nor wise policy, but in both cases mere unskillfulness; and in the latter, unjust as well as unfeeling.
author: Plutarch
locator: Comparison of Tiberius and Caius Gracchus with Agis and Cleomenes
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
